dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Maxine is on the at-risk list due to behavior concerns. In the care center, Maxine has shown fearful behavior around leashing, including dodging the leash and darting back and forth between kennels, requiring the transfer door to be closed in order to safely leash her. She has also recently been observed consistently scratching at her kennel walls. Once out of her kennel, Maxine is able to explore calmly and return to her kennel without issue. Medically, Maxine is blind geriatric small dog, recently recovered from CIRDC, and is would benefit from a dental if she can be cleared to be an appropiate anesthetic candidate.

What my friends at ACC say about me:

I have medical needs that staff will address with you when you meet me.

I love to be loved, but on my own terms! Let's brush up on some canine body language together!

I would do best in a home with only adult humans.
dog.name: Maxine
